2. Assessor model (B8; DR-11; interface I5). Run the bake-off the team asked for after system testing: 15-25 recent real 8-K/6-K filings for the five issuers, fetched by our own tools; measure schema-valid rate, claim-verification pass rate, latency within the 60 s / 6-tool budget, and cost per assessment.
